clues: This city stands in the north of a long land in the south east of Asia. Lakes rest in its heart, and a flat river delta spreads around it.
This city has four clear seasons in the year. Winter winds from the north east bring cool, dry air, while summers are hot, wet, and humid.
In the year 1010 an emperor made this place his capital. He named the city for a dragon he said he saw rise from the river.
This northern city holds the top job in its land. It rules the nation, even though a larger city stands far to the south.
This city hosts the embassies of many lands and the chief office of the army of Vietnam. The nation's government sits here.
